scope: Read-only review of root administrator setup package; no administrative execution

facts.signer: CN=Microsoft Corporation, O=Microsoft Corporation, L=Redmond, S=Washington, C=US

findings.reason: SC suffix cannot be applied to version140 collations; all140 are supplementary-character-aware.

Get-Command sqlcmd/sqlcmd.exe resolves two paths in actual WindowsPowerShell5. Native deployers take .Source as array, web deployers coerce multiple .Source values into a string. The root package currently passes no explicit path.
findings.proposedFix: Resolve one reviewed modern sqlcmd absolute path before removal/install and pass SqlcmdPath to WPF/VB, SqlCmdPath to MVC/Vue.

bootstrapMetadata.inspectionMode: ReflectionOnlyLoad of signed executable bytes and embedded assemblies; no entry point/method invocation
bootstrapMetadata.languageConclusion: /LANG=en-US has declared alias and locale example; keep argument.
bootstrapMetadata.mediaConclusion: Calculate checks edition expr case-insensitively and sets AllowedValues to enum Core/LocalDB; /MEDIATYPE=Core is valid. SampleMediaTypeExpress resource Expr is a usage sample, not the allowed enum value list.

reviewedBehavior: Old registered engines or running sqlservr cause abort before LocalDB removal
Exact3 LocalDB product GUIDs matched read-only local uninstall inventory
No database file deletion or existingDB drop; project scripts refuse existingDB creation
Explicit quoting for path/service/Windows identity arguments; literal MSSQL$SQLEXPRESS preserved
localhost/computer SAN, legacy RSA SChannel exchange key, public certificate only, serviceRead ACL
Non-loopback TCP disabled, browser/namedpipes disabled, no firewall rule
TrustServerCertificate=False and encryption plus edition/version/windows-only/TLS assertions
Failures saved and installer/child exit status checked; UAC cancellation not retried; launcher only claims STARTED

conditionalConcerns.detail: 3010 sets rebootRequired and continues subsequent patch/install. Pending reboot may make the next stage fail; consider explicit stop/resume policy, not confirmed actual failure.
Loopback IP keys must exist and port1433 must be free. Final validated TLS connection catches failure. No live listener1433 was observed and no configuration was changed.

A PS5 subprocess launched through Python inherited the Codex PowerShell module path and could not auto-load Security. Explicit system WindowsPowerShell Security import worked; direct powershell.exe invocation auto-loaded it correctly. Administrator launcher behavior was not executed. Use system PS5 modules if the launcher inherits a PS7 module path.
Partial installation/createdDB remain on later failure. Rerun requires operator decision; never auto-drop/repair.

conclusion: Collation fix observed; explicit single sqlcmd path requested. LANG/Core have signed metadata support. Runtime deployment not verified.
